scope: bounded offline model reference, compatibility and license-attestation boundary

capability_contract.license_with_attestation: ATTESTED and bound to current artifact SHA-256

limitations: Capability aliases are conservative declaration checks; they do not load or execute user models.
Real user model files, Windows three-viewport UAT and final legal license review remain outstanding.
This evidence does not claim that a model license is valid or that a runtime can execute it.
release_claim: The platform stores only a local absolute path and immutable offline hashes/attestation metadata; incompatible declared capability is hard-blocked and no model bytes are packaged or uploaded.
